passage.text: Welcome to Khao Yai National Park!
passage.reading: ˈwɛlkəm tə ˈkaʊ ˈjaɪ ˈnæʃənəl ˈpɑːrk!

passage.text: Please follow these rules on your visit.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz ˈfɑːloʊ ðiːz ˈruːlz ɑːn jʊr ˈvɪzɪt.

passage.text: Don't feed the animals. Food from people makes them sick.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈfiːd ði ˈænɪməlz. ˈfuːd frəm ˈpiːpəl ˈmeɪks ðɛm ˈsɪk.

passage.text: Elephants sometimes walk on the road. Stop your car at a safe distance and wait.
passage.reading: ˈɛləfənts ˈsʌmtaɪmz ˈwɔːk ɑːn ðə ˈroʊd. ˈstɑːp jʊr ˈkɑːr ət ə ˈseɪf ˈdɪstəns ənd ˈweɪt.

passage.text: Don't litter. Take your trash home with you.
passage.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈlɪtər. ˈteɪk jʊr ˈtræʃ ˈhoʊm wɪð juː.

passage.text: Stay on the trails, and don't walk in the forest at night.
passage.reading: ˈsteɪ ɑːn ðə ˈtreɪlz, ənd ˈdoʊnt ˈwɔːk ɪn ðə ˈfɔːrɪst ət ˈnaɪt.

passage.text: Please be quiet. Noise frightens the animals.
passage.reading: ˈpliːz bi ˈkwaɪət. ˈnɔɪz ˈfraɪtənz ði ˈænɪməlz.

passage.text: Park rangers are at the visitor center from 6 a.m. to 6 p.m.
passage.reading: ˈpɑːrk ˌreɪndʒərz ər ət ðə ˈvɪzɪtər ˌsɛntər frəm ˈsɪks ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈsɪks ˌpiːˈɛm.
